## Court Proceedings
Contains the guidelines for hlding the different types of hearings
### Summary Hearings
A quick, informal judgment for minor offenses.
### Formal Hearings
A lengthier, formal hearing for more severe crimes.
### Trials
Trials are an extremely in-depth, formal procedure, only for the most severe crimes.
